Page 5 


Add the following new Annex A following Clause 12. 


Amendment No. 1 to IS 13962 : 2018/ISO 10317 : 2008 


Annex A 
(informative) 


Comparison of tolerance class designations for single-row tapered 
roller bearings 


This annex gives a comparison table of alternative tolerance class designations for single-row tapered 
roller bearings as defined in ISO 492. 


Tolerances for double-row bearings are not defined in ISO 492. For this reason, it is not possible to apply 
the comparison table to double-row tapered roller bearings. 


Table A.1 shows the relationship between the ISO tolerance classes of ISO 492 and tolerance class 
designations as given in Table 3 (ofthis International Standard), as well as the tolerance class designations 
as given in ANSI/ABMA 19.1. 


Table A.1 — Tolerance class designation for single-row tapered roller bearings 


Symbol in this Tolerance class in

a “/” may be omitted. 
The tolerances of double-row bearing are not specified in ISO 492.
